description: Run AI contract analysis on an envelope's document (any status, DRAFT included). The document is sent to SignaTrust's servers and analysed there by a third-party AI model (Google Gemini), so ask the user for explicit consent for THIS document before calling it: SignaTrust's policy is that server-side AI on a document needs per-document consent. Returns a structured report covering risk assessment, flagged clauses, and overall sentiment (SAFE / CAUTION / RISKY). Available on every plan. Refused with a 403 when the organization has switched AI processing off or is in HIPAA mode; surface that message rather than retrying. Each call runs a new, paid AI analysis.
name: analyze_document
